summary: A correctness and speed release: LZ4 block compression is fixed, the contract verifier emits valid SMT-LIB, scripting no longer indexes the system temp tree, and compile-time caches cut warm builds sharply.

highlights.title: LZ4 block compression fixed
highlights.text: LZ4 block compression could read back an empty result in programs compiled on v0.62.2-v0.62.4. The 2^32-element Vec growth ceiling added in v0.62.2 lowered through a movabs and an x86 peephole pass then miscompiled the compressor; the ceiling is now 2^32-1 elements and byte buffers above 16 MB keep working.

highlights.title: Contract verifier emits valid SMT-LIB
highlights.text: z3 verification failed to parse the generated SMT for many obligations (duplicate named expressions, undeclared initialized/self symbols, sort mismatches). It now produces unique labels, never emits undeclared symbols, matches selectors, guards operators by sort, and reports unmodeled obligations as UNKNOWN.

highlights.title: xiom run no longer indexes the temp tree
highlights.text: Scripting compiled a copy under the system temp directory, and the compiler registered the temp root as a source directory whenever a stray .xi file sat there, indexing every unrelated tree under temp. Temp-root ancestors are never registered now; cold script runs dropped from minutes to seconds.

highlights.title: Compile-time caches
highlights.text: The C runtime is compiled to objects once per (clang, flags, contents) tuple and reused, and the catalog's module-header index is cached persistently. Measured on the dev driver: hello-world 8.7s to 0.97s warm, the LZ4 program 13.3s to 4.0s warm.

highlights.title: Verifier CLI speed and safety
highlights.text: The standalone verifier no longer treats the temp root as a source directory and reuses the catalog index cache: its integration suite went from over 10 minutes (timing out) to under 8 seconds.

highlights.title: Doctor and timing tooling
highlights.text: xiom doctor compares major.minor version lines only (patch differences and tag-shaped pins no longer warn), and XIOM_TIMINGS=1 reports the catalog-index phase and per-module catalog check stats.

known_issues: iter.range.contains (C001) can fail run-to-run nondeterministically on some programs (classifier state); the standard library releases carry a documented exclusion until it is fixed.
reflect.all_types() can corrupt the heap (catalog-return path); fix scheduled.
Range.collect() closure forward-reference remains open on the clause side; fix scheduled.
